text: Third time this week the printer jammed right before a deadline. I wanted to throw it out the window.
Two hours on hold with the airline. Disconnected. Started again.
Asked Calum to take the bins out four times. Bins still in. Calum still on the sofa.
Great, another 'quick' meeting that ran for ninety minutes and decided nothing.
I've rewritten this paragraph eight times and it's still bad. I know what I want to say. Why won't it come out.
The physio said progress will be slow. I knew that. I just hate not being able to run.
Train cancelled, replacement bus took a scenic tour of every village in the county. Home at 10pm.
Javier keeps taking credit for my work in front of the director. I don't know how to call it out without looking petty.
Why do I always freeze up when I'm speaking French with actual French people. I can do it perfectly in my head.
The insurance company 'needs more documents'. They have had every document since March.
Couldn't get the baby to nap. Tried everything. She finally fell asleep at 5:30pm, perfect for ruining tonight.
Wifi keeps dropping during calls. I look like a frozen potato to my clients.
Same argument with Mum about the wedding guest list. Round five. Nobody wins.
I'm stuck. Six months at this job and I'm doing exactly what I did on day one. No growth, no plan, no feedback.
Burnt the risotto because I answered one email. One.
Ugh. Planned a whole day of writing and got nothing done except reorganising my bookshelf.
The council approved the tower block on the park despite everyone objecting. What was the consultation even for?
Kids fought all the way to Grandma's. Four hours of 'he's touching me'. I have no patience left.
My knee is still swollen. It's been three weeks. I've done everything the doctor said.
Lost again at chess to Ivan. Same opening trap. Every. Single. Time.
Spent the whole weekend on the furniture flatpack and there's one piece left over and the drawer won't close.
I'm not angry at Nkechi, I'm just frustrated that we keep having the same conversation about money and nothing changes.
Website crashed on launch day. Hundreds of people trying to sign up and getting an error page.
Spent an hour looking for my keys. They were in my hand. I'm losing it.
Applied to forty jobs. Two replies, both automatic rejections. I'm qualified, I'm just invisible.
Bureaucracy day: three offices, two forms, one stamp, zero progress.
Kaito cancelled on me again, one hour before. Fourth time. I'm done planning things with him.
My body won't let me sleep even though I'm exhausted. Lying here doing the maths on how many hours I'll get.
Every time I think the code works there's another bug hiding behind it. Like whack-a-mole.
Annoyed with myself. Promised I'd go to the gym. Watched three episodes instead.
The neighbour's dog barked from 5am. I've asked nicely twice. I'm out of nice.
Supervisor Grace moved the goalposts on the project for the third time. I've basically done it three times over.
Couldn't figure out the tax form. Called the helpline. They couldn't figure it out either.
Wanted a peaceful Sunday. Got a leaking boiler, a toddler with a cold and a broken umbrella.
Rejected by the gallery again with the same feedback: 'not quite right for us'. What does that mean?
Can't get the hang of this guitar chord. My fingers just won't. Two weeks of practice.
The groceries were delivered to the wrong flat and now I'm making dinner out of crackers and hope.
I keep explaining to my parents that I'm not 'just playing on the computer', it's literally my job.
Exam was nothing like the practice papers. I knew the material and still messed it up.
Lovely, the car failed its MOT. On my birthday. Perfect timing as always.
Three days into the new diet and I ate an entire pack of biscuits in the car. Back to day one.
Ferdinand interrupted me in every single meeting today. I tracked it. Seven times.
Hours on hold with the GP surgery, then all the appointments were gone by the time I got through.
I just can't get through to Theo. He nods and then does exactly the opposite.
Stuck in traffic for two hours because of roadworks that nobody is actually working on.
I hate that I let it get to me. Nita made one little comment and I stewed on it all day.
Landlord still hasn't fixed the mould. Three emails, two calls, a letter. Kids are coughing.
Wrote 2,000 words and the file didn't save. Rewriting from memory. Never as good the second time.
I'm frustrated with how slow this healing is. Physically and the other kind.
Group chat planning a trip: 47 messages, zero decisions. Again.
The software update moved every button I use. Spent half the morning hunting for 'export'.
Missed the penalty in the final. The whole team said it's fine. It isn't fine to me.
Ma keeps sending me articles about 'settling down'. I'm 29. I have a life. I'm settled.
Long day of nothing working. The oven, the heating, the bus, my brain.
Rejected the visa on a technicality. A missing stamp. Months of waiting for this.
Why is it so hard to just ask for help? I needed it. I didn't ask. Then I stayed late again.
Deliveroo order arrived cold and missing the main thing I ordered. On the one night I didn't want to cook.
Struggled with the recipe Babcia gave me. Mine tastes nothing like hers. Tried three times.
My research participant cancelled for the fourth time and the ethics deadline is next week.
Can't concentrate. Kept starting things and dropping them. Whole day felt like wading through mud.
Apparently 'urgent' means 'Cormac forgot to tell you about it until today'.
The new hire keeps asking me questions he could just google. I'm happy to help but I have my own work.
Spent my day off fixing someone else's mistake. Again.
Trying to get my dad to see a doctor about his cough. He just changes the subject.
Not really upset, just irritated. Everything took twice as long as it should have.
Lost the bid by one vote. Three months of work. They picked the cheaper, worse plan.
I tried to talk to Pilar about how I've been feeling and she turned it into a story about herself.
Every form wants a utility bill and I don't have one in my name because I just moved. Catch-22.
The bread didn't rise. Again. I followed the recipe to the gram.
I want to move forward and every door I push on is locked. That's this whole month.
